sources.title: More than 250 jobs at risk as Nokia plans cuts in Finland
sources.description: Nokia is planning to cut up to 253 positions in Finland. The company wants to reduce costs and redirect resources towards areas such as defence, AI and data centres.

sources.title: Nokia quits R&D facility in China and cuts 1,600 jobs
sources.description: The closure of a Nokia facility in Hangzhou will lead to about 1,600 job cuts and comes after the Finnish vendor took full control of its China business.

sources.title: Nokia says it will cut up to 14,000 jobs
sources.description: By Michelle Toh, CNN Hong Kong (CNN) — Nokia will slash up to 14,000 jobs in a major cost-cutting drive to address a “weaker” market environment, it said in a statement on Thursday. sources.title: Nokia Plans to Cut 14,000 Jobs in Overhaul to Shave Costs
sources.description: Nokia Oyj plans to cut as many as 14,000 jobs, or 16% of its workforce, as a dearth of investment in fifth-generation mobile infrastructure forces it to take cost-cutting measures.
